# This model demonstrates the use of the utility class ChBuilderCableANCF.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Model1:
    def __init__(self, system, mesh):
        # Create a section, i.e. define thickness and material properties for the cable beam
        msection_cable2 = fea.ChBeamSectionCable()
        msection_cable2.SetDiameter(0.015)  # Set the diameter of the cable section to 15 mm
        msection_cable2.SetYoungModulus(0.01e9)  # Set the Young's modulus of the cable section (0.01 GPa)
        msection_cable2.SetRayleighDamping(0.0001)  # Set Rayleigh damping to zero for this section
        # Create a ChBuilderCableANCF helper object to facilitate the creation of ANCF beams
        builder = fea.ChBuilderCableANCF()
        # Use BuildBeam to create a beam structure consisting of ANCF elements:
        builder.BuildBeam(
            mesh,  # The mesh to which the created nodes and elements will be added
            msection_cable2,  # The beam section properties to use
            10,  # Number of ANCF elements to create along the beam
            chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -0.1),  # Starting point ('A' point) of the beam
            chrono.ChVector3d(0.5, 0, -0.1)  # Ending point ('B' point) of the beam
        )

        # Apply boundary conditions and loads:
        # Retrieve the end nodes of the beam and apply load/constraints
        builder.GetLastBeamNodes().front().SetForce(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -0.7, 0))  # Apply forces to the front node

        # Create a truss body (a fixed reference frame in the simulation)
        mtruss = chrono.ChBody()
        mtruss.SetFixed(True)  # Fix the truss body

        # Create and initialize a hinge constraint to fix beam's end point to the truss
        constraint_hinge = fea.ChLinkNodeFrame()
        constraint_hinge.Initialize(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back(), mtruss)
        system.Add(constraint_hinge)  # Add the constraint to the system

        end_pos = chrono.ChVectorD(0.5, 0, -0.1)
        total_length = (end_pos - start_pos).Length()

            # Create a truss body (a fixed reference frame in the simulation)
            mtruss = chrono.ChBody()
            mtruss.SetFixed(True)  # Fix the truss body

            # Create and initialize a hinge constraint to fix beam's end point to the truss
            constraint_hinge = fea.ChLinkNodeFrame()
            constraint_hinge.Initialize(builder.GetLastBeamNodes().back(), mtruss)

            # Set the starting position for the next chain
            start_pos = end_pos

            # Create a new end position for the next chain
            end_pos = start_pos + chrono.ChVectorD(total_length / n_chains * (i + 1), 0, 0)

            # Calculate the new length of the chain
            new_length = (end_pos - start_pos).Length()

            # Update the total length and number of elements for the new chain
            total_length += new_length
            builder.BuildBeam(
                self.mesh,  # The mesh to which the created nodes and elements will be added

                start_pos,  # Starting point ('A' point) of the beam

        visualizebeamB.SetFEMdataType(chrono.ChVisualShapeFEA.DataType_NONE)  # No additional FEM data visualization
        visualizebeamB.SetSymbolsThickness(0.006)  # Set thickness of symbols
        visualizebeamB.SetSymbolsScale(0.01)  # Set scale of symbols
        visualizebeamB.SetZbufferHide(False)  # Ensure symbols are not hidden by z-buffer
        self.mesh.AddVisualShapeFEA(visualizebeamB)  # Add the node visualization to the mesh

        # Create the Irrlicht visualization for rendering
        vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
        vis.AttachSystem(self.system)  # Attach Irrlicht to the Chrono system
        vis.SetWindowSize(1024, 768)  # Set the size of the rendering window
        vis.SetWindowTitle('FEA cables')  # Set the title of the rendering window
        vis.Initialize()  # Initialize the visualization
        vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))  # Add a logo to the window
        vis.AddSkyBox()  # Add a skybox for better aesthetics
        vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.6, -1))  # Add a camera with specific position
        vis.AddTypicalLights()  # Add typical lights for better illumination

        # Set solver type and settings
        solver = chrono.ChSolverMINRES()  # Choose SparseQR solver
        if solver.GetType() == chrono.ChSolver.Type_MINRES:
            print("Using MINRES solver")
        self.system.SetSolver(solver)
        solver.SetMaxIterations(200)
        solver.SetTolerance(1e-10)
        solver.EnableDiagonalPreconditioner(True)
        solver.EnableWarmStart(True)  # IMPORTANT for convergence when using EULER_IMPLICIT_LINEARIZED
        solver.SetVerbose(False)
        # Set the timestepper for the simulation
        ts = chrono.ChTimestepperEulerImplicitLinearized(self.system)
        self.system.SetTimestepper(ts)

        # Simulation loop

            vis.Render()  # Render the scene
            vis.EndScene()  # End scene rendering
            self.system.DoStepDynamics(0.01)  # Advance the simulation by one step with a time step of 0.01 seconds

    def PrintBodyPositions(self):

            print(f"Chain {i + 1} end body position: {self.system.GetBody(i).GetPos()}")

fromchrono = __import__('chrono')
fromchronoimportchrono as chrono
frompychronoimportchrono as pychrono
frompychronoimportirrlichtengine
frompychronoimportchronoengine
frompychronoimportvisual
frompychronoimportgeometry
frompychronoimportrigidbody
frompychronoimportjoint
frompychronoimportmaterial
frompychronoimportvisualmodel

# Initialize PyChrono environment
pychrono.Initialize()

# Create a new PyChrono world
world = pychrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Set gravity
world.SetGravity(pychrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))

# Create ground
ground = pychrono.ChBodyEasyBox(100, 1, 1, 1000)
ground.SetPos(pychrono.ChVectorD(0, -1, 0))
ground.SetBodyFixed(True)
world.Add(ground)

# Define parameters for ANCF cable elements
cable_length = 1.0
cable_mass_density = 1000.0
cable_cross_section_area = 0.001
cable_cross_section_perimeter = 0.002
cable_young_modulus = 2.0e11
cable_poisson_ratio = 0.3

# Create a function to create ANCF cable element
def create_cable_element(length, mass_density, cross_section_area, cross_section_perimeter, young_modulus, poisson_ratio):
    cable = pychrono.ChLinkTSDA()
    cable.SetMaterialProperties(mass_density, cross_section_area, cross_section_perimeter, young_modulus, poisson_ratio)
    cable.SetLength(length)
    cable.SetMassPerLength(mass_density / length)
    cable.SetFixedEnd1(True)
    cable.SetFixedEnd2(False)
    cable.SetSpringStiffness(1e6)
    cable.SetDampingRatio(0.1)
    return cable

# Create a beam composed of ANCF cable elements
num_elements = 5
cable_elements = []
for i in range(num_elements):
    element_length = cable_length / num_elements
    element = create_cable_element(element_length, cable_mass_density, cable_cross_section_area, cable_cross_section_perimeter, cable_young_modulus, cable_poisson_ratio)
    world.Add(element)
    cable_elements.append(element)

# Connect cable elements to form a beam
for i in range(num_elements - 1):
    cable_elements[i].SetFixedEnd2(False)
    cable_elements[i + 1].SetFixedEnd1(False)
    cable_elements[i].SetFixedEnd1(False)
    cable_elements[i].SetFixedEnd2(cable_elements[i + 1].GetId())
    cable_elements[i + 1].SetFixedEnd1(cable_elements[i].GetId())

# Add the beam to the world
world.Add(cable_elements[0])

# Create a visual model for the beam
visual_model = visualmodel.ChVisualModel()
visual_model.SetMaterialProperties(1000.0, 0.001, 0.002, 2.0e11, 0.3)
visual_model.SetMeshFile("beam.stl")
visual_model.SetRenderMode(visualmodel.ChVisualModel.RenderMode.MESH)
visual_model.SetRenderColor(visualmodel.ChVisualModel.RenderMode.MESH, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0)
visual_model.SetRenderColor(visualmodel.ChVisualModel.RenderMode.SURF, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
visual_model.SetRenderWireframe(True)
visual_model.SetRenderWireframeColor(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
visual_model.SetRenderWireframeThickness(0.01)
world.AddVisualModel(visual_model)

# Set up Irrlicht visualization
engine = irrlichtengine.IrrlichtEngine()
engine.SetWindowSize(800, 600)
engine.SetWindowCaption("Beam Simulation")
engine.SetVSync(True)
engine.SetTargetFPS(60)
engine.AttachWorld(world)

# Start the simulation loop
while engine.IsRunning():
    engine.BeginScene()
    engine.DrawAll()
    world.DoStepDynamics(1.0 / 60.0)
    engine.EndScene()
    engine.ProcessEvents()

# Close the Irrlicht engine and PyChrono environment
engine.Close()
pychrono.Finalize()
